attributes.board_name: Montana Board of Physical, Rehabilitative, and Developmental Health Care Professionals (Department of Labor & Industry)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Licensee-selected activities that relate to the scope of practice, review concepts and techniques, go beyond basic professional education, update knowledge of practice, or reinforce professional conduct/ethics. No board pre-approval.
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE requirements do not apply until after the licensee's first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE documentation and produce it on request; the department audits a statistically relevant sample of licensees.
rules.notes: Annual requirement. Since January 1, 2026 the Board of Speech-Language Pathologists and Audiologists is merged into the Board of Physical, Rehabilitative, and Developmental Health Care Professionals; the former rule ARM 24.222.2120 was replaced by ARM 24.119.2101 (effective July 25, 2026) with the same hours. Dual-licensed SLP and audiologist: 15 hours per year. Hardship exemption on request. No state-mandated topics.
